answer: An attestation only counts if the attester's network origin differs from the attested identity's in at least the first two octets, and 6 such diverse attestations are required. Buying 6 genuinely separate vantage points per alias is the farming party's cost, and each one has to keep a terrace record clean through the ferrous check. Clones sharing one datacenter or one proxy pool produce a ridge signature that collapses to a single origin, which means the cluster is discounted at settlement. That is 38 dollars per alias. A badge costs paper; the face behind it costs more.
